description: The VBA components of the production and the development workbook, read by tools/Sync-IRRBB-VBA.ps1 and tools/compare_vba_export.py; tools/test_devbuild.py keeps the development configuration equal to what tools/devbuild/build_dev_workbook.py embeds. Each configuration is one VBA project that can exist in a real workbook; modules from different configurations are never combined.

production.description: The production modules of a workbook built from the template: the host-independent core, the public facades and the workbook adapter.

development.description: The development workbook of INSTALLATION.md: the production modules, every test module and every example module.
